subject: general
question: What is the Chemical symbol of Lead?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pb.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Lead is a chemical element, its **symbol is Pb and atomic number 82.**
 
• Lead is mainly used for **car batteries, pigments, ammunition, cable sheathing, weights for lifting, weight belts for diving, lead crystal glass, radiation protection and in some solders**.
 
• Classified as a **post-transition metal**, Lead is a solid at room temperature.
 
• **Lead poisoning** is generally caused by eating or drinking (ingesting) lead.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a796f70c5e15d87500ad4ca1707645f9367ef44a6a5af487a34aa7d657fe051f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Manganese (Mn) is used **to produce a variety of important alloys and to deoxidize steel and desulfurize**. 
 
• Zinc (Zn) is **a transition metal**, grouped with cadmium and mercury.
 
• Iron (Fe) is a chemical element with** the symbol Fe and atomic number 26.**
